import html from typing import List # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

{content}
{labels}
""" def render_blog_post( author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a secure HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str The heading/title of the user's post. content : str Primary textual content of the post. labels : list[str] Sequence of tags/labels associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string of the formatted post. Notes ----- All user supplied data is escaped using `html.escape` to neutralize any special characters that could lead to injection attacks (CWE‑74). """ # Escape all user input to avoid HTML injection safe_author_id = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Escape each label and wrap it in a element escaped_labels = [ f'{html.escape(label, quote=True)}' for label in labels ] safe_labels = " ".join(escaped_labels) # Format the final HTML using the predefined template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author_id, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels ) return rendered.strip()
